children: CBOT December corn (CZ26) may retest a support at $5.33-1/2 per bushel, a break below could trigger a fall to $5.27-1/4.
The contract has fallen below a rising channel. A duplicated channel indicates a target around $5.27-1/4. The bearish divergence on the hourly MACD suggests a further fall.

Resistance is at $5.42-1/4, a break above could lead to a gain into the range of $5.45-1/2 to $5.49. On the daily chart, the contract failed to break a resistance at $5.48-3/4, the 138.2% projection level of a wave C from $4.57-1/4.
The failure marks the beginning of a downward wave 4, which may travel to $5.28-1/4. Upon completion of this wave, the market may resume its rise, driven by the wave 5.
